name: Microsoft Clarity Data Export API
description: Download Microsoft Clarity dashboard data programmatically for advanced analysis and system integration. Returns dashboard insights (traffic, engagement, scroll depth, rage clicks, script errors, and more) as JSON over the last 1-3 days, broken down by up to three dimensions. Limits: 10 requests per project per day; response capped at 1,000 rows, no pagination; results in UTC.
